g.text: R15 selection rule, declared before running: n_overlap ≥ 100; the disease GWAS has ≥ 1 variant with p < 5×10⁻⁸ inside the merged gene window; one locus per target by largest overlap; no cap.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: R14.1 omitted the disease-significance criterion, so it admitted loci with no disease signal — its residual-z values on the disease side are an artefact of that and are withdrawn, shown only for comparison.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Of the R14.1 60-locus set, 28 completed and 32 are excluded as superseded. The residual-z diagnostic is DENTIST (Chen et al. 2021, Nat Commun 12:7117); the implementation is ours, the method is theirs.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Colocalization figures are method availability, not evidence: Gate D is closed as a documented negative result. One R14.1 locus (CA2) has a non-finite disease-side residual-z and is excluded from that row only, so its n is 27 against 28 elsewhere.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555
